title: A week of every bus in Kuala Lumpur
description:
A week of every bus in Kuala Lumpur, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Kuala Lumpur city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Trunk, Local and MRT feeder, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 198 buses, Monday at 7:30 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable. MRT Feeder Bus has fewer than three usable October Sundays, so its Sunday uses one typical date.
